description: Liquidität: balance (Kontostand) of every payment account (Zahlungskonto) on asOf as sevDesk computes it, with totals per currency. With outlookDays it adds an expected view from today to asOf + N days: receivables (Forderungen) and payables (Verbindlichkeiten) due by due date (Zahlungsziel/Fälligkeit), expected net and projected balance, labelled expected, not booked; overdue items are shown apart, and asOf must then be today or later. Prefer it over combining sevdesk_bank_accounts_list with invoice and voucher lists. Computed by this server from sevDesk records, not a sevDesk report.

asOf.description: Day of the balances (Stichtag), YYYY-MM-DD; default today (Berlin). With outlookDays it must be today or later (sevDesk only knows today's open items).

outlookDays.description: Add the expected in- and outflows due within this many days after asOf.
